queries: Yann LeCun 2024 common sense physical world models LLM interview

sources_considered.why: Primary interview record of LeCun's views on physical understanding, common sense, world models and LLM limitations.
Read to verify the episode's March 7, 2024 publication date.
The conference organizer reports Marcus's January 2024 criticism of current systems.
Documents other researchers emphasizing world models and reasoning limitations during the target period.
Read and considered; the longer primary podcast transcript covers the relevant LeCun position more fully.

evidence_items.locator: LeCun's answer beginning at 00:11:10; see also 00:02:47, 00:17:58 and 01:02:57
evidence_items.explanation: The interview supports the attribution to LeCun: he emphasizes missing physical understanding and discusses world models and common sense as requirements. It establishes his stated position, not the technical truth of that position.

evidence_items.locator: Conference summary, paragraph quoting Marcus on statistical patterns
evidence_items.explanation: The event organizer documents Marcus criticizing current systems for lacking world understanding. The summary does not independently document his complete three-part prescription.

evidence_items.publisher: Zhiting Hu and Tianmin Shu, AAAI 2024 tutorial
evidence_items.explanation: Other researchers publicly emphasized unreliable world knowledge and the value of world models. This cautions against treating the position as distinctive, but two examples cannot disprove a contrast with an unspecified 'many'.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved independent record does not document every element of Marcus's attributed prescription during the target window.
No defined comparison population or representative evidence establishes the contrast with 'many other people'.
